verses.theme: Condemnation of killing prophets and advocates of justice
Warning that perpetrators' deeds fail and they lack helpers
People given scripture invited to adjudication by God's book; some turn away
Claim of punishment lasting only numbered days
Gathering and just recompense on the Day of Judgment
Prayer affirming God grants and removes dominion and honor
God's control of day/night, life/death and provision
Warning about taking unbelievers as allies, with a self-protection qualification
God knows hidden and revealed thoughts and all things
Every soul confronted with its good and evil deeds

candidates.relationship: specific earlier motif: killing admonishing prophets
candidates.similarity: Both condemn the killing of prophets who oppose wrongdoing.
candidates.difference: Nehemiah 9:26 is a retrospective confession about Israel's ancestors and prophets calling for return; Qur'an 3:21 condemns killers of prophets AND those commanding justice and announces punishment.
